summary: Tested PDF 'Base documentaire prise en compte' encart feature. 13/13 tests passed. Found 1 BUG in readability level logic: all ocr_extracted shows 'Tres bonne' instead of 'Bonne'.

critical.issue: Readability level logic bug: when all documents are ocr_extracted, shows 'Tres bonne' instead of 'Bonne'. The condition order is wrong - 'Tres bonne' condition (mixed text+ocr) matches before 'Bonne' (all ocr) because all(s in ('text_extracted', 'ocr_extracted')) is TRUE for all ocr_extracted.
critical.fix: Reorder conditions: check 'all ocr_extracted' BEFORE 'mixed text+ocr'. Move lines 293-294 before lines 291-292.
